note: Rule-by-rule outcomes. Precision here is confirmed / (confirmed + false positive) and is null where a rule produced too few rows or no confirmed rows to divide by. `kind` separates capability descriptors from weakness findings; the weakness block is the one that matters. Findings per 1,000 lines uses the scanned source total of 171,711 lines across 1,711 code files.
